head: ed49afe43eedb5f6e4e2d2678f19dca8261c42ed
summary:
The fix for O-009 removes the defect, and it introduces nothing new.

**What changed:**
- `blockedComment` gains a `ParentUnpublished` field, set at admin.go:480 as `bc.Reply && !c.Published`.
- admin_blocked.html:20 now picks one of three labels for a reply:
  - a link to the parent;
  - ', in reply to a comment (the report has no reader page)' for a reply on a draft or unpublished report;
  - ', in reply to a hidden comment' only for a published report whose parent the thread does not draw.
- The test is at internal/server/blocked_unpublished_label_test.go, unchanged from the one I gave.

**What I ran on ed49afe:**
- The repro passes: `go test -count=1 -run ^TestBlockedPageUnpublishedReplyIsNotToAHiddenComment$ ./internal/server`. It failed on 1753d3f.
- TestBlockedPage, TestBlock, TestBlockedRefusals, TestUnblockRestores, TestBlockControls, TestAdminAccessMatrix, TestDislikesDoNotInterfere and TestFeedbackDoesNotInterfere all pass. TestBlockedPage still requires 'in reply to a hidden comment' for the hidden-parent entry, and an admin link with no #comment- anchor for the unpublished one.
- The full suite `go test -count=1 -p 4 ./...` passes.
- Both E-006 finish-line bodies from epic 44 exit 0 against the real binary in a scratch copy: test_e006_1_removal_and_placeholders.py and test_e006_2_blocking_and_unblocking.py. That matters because those readers parse the li text this fix changed.

**Read as someone trying to break it:**
- A top-level comment on an unpublished report gets no label.
- A removed reply on an unpublished report gets the new wording.
- A published report's undrawn parent is still called hidden.

The two doc comments that described the old behaviour were rewritten in the same diff: the type doc at admin.go:427-437 and the adminBlocked doc at :458-462. Both are true of the code.

**Not acted on, as decided:** the stale `comments.ErrBlocked` doc and the two 'six ways' test comments (O-010 to O-013) were waived to notes and are still unchanged.

Second round: This round found nothing new; I walked the changed code again looking for inputs and paths that break it.

**Parsers and readers.** This slice adds no new parser of an outside format.
- The block and unblock routes read only the path id, through the existing `canonicalID`, which rejects 0, signs, leading zeros, spaces and percent-encodings. They never read the body.
- `removeFrom` only gained an exact-match value, 'blocked'. The corpus already feeds it urlencoded and multipart bodies, aliases, repeats, wrong case and oversize bodies.
- The tests' regular expressions use `\s*` and `(?s)`, so they read CRLF and LF template output alike.

**Boundaries.**
- Every Book in the tree is built through `New`, so the `isBlocked` seam is never nil. The only callers are router.go:71-73 and comment_test.go:80.
- An account with no comments, no users row or no report row is COALESCEd in `blockedSQL`. Its rows stay together because `github_id` is the table's primary key and the query orders by `blocked_at`, then `github_id`.
- `Find` on the pruned forest locates a parent only where the page draws an element with id `comment-<n>`, placeholders included.
- A thread read cached as nil still counts as seen in `forests`, so it is not read twice.
- The bool scans of SQLite 0 and 1 values are exercised by tests that pass.

**Error and partial-failure paths.**
- `adminBlocked` renders only after every read has succeeded, so a failure never sends half a page; it is a 500.
- A block that succeeds followed by a 500 on the page it lands on leaves the block in place, which is correct.

**Check, release, act.** Every refusal happens inside the single write statement. The follow-up read only chooses the answer. An unblock landing between the two can make a refused Withdraw answer 303, or a refused Post answer 404. Nothing is written in either case, and the account is already unblocked by then, so no second caller gets past a refusal.

**Fix batch.** O-009 is fixed at admin.go:480 and admin_blocked.html:20. Its test, both E-006 finish lines (epic 44) and the full suite all pass on ed49afe.

obligations.evidence: Unchanged from the first full read. The fix touches only the Blocked users page's reply label. The SC-021 tests and both E-006 finish lines (epic 44) pass again on ed49afe, re-run in this review.
Unchanged: admin_blocked.html:22-28 still draws the from=blocked remove two-step, and admin.go handles from=blocked first. TestUnblockRestores passes on ed49afe.
Unchanged: thread.go modItem.ParentHidden and admin_report.html:46 'in reply to a hidden comment'. TestBlockControls passes.
Unchanged: block.go:30-44 holds the owner refusal and fails closed, router.go:72 binds the owner id, and admin.go maps ErrOwnerBlock to 400. TestBlock passes.
Unchanged: comments.go, votes.go and feedback.go wrap a failed follow-up read. The full suite passes on ed49afe.
Unchanged: branch_test.go:111-115 and :445-463. The full suite passes.

admin.go:480-497: parents are resolved only for published reports, through a.tree, Find and branchRoot. TestBlockedPage still covers a parent below the cap, a hidden parent, an unpublished report and the 500s. The unpublished wording is now separate (O-009).
Unchanged: .taad/fitness.yaml. The engine measured the architecture rules passing after this build.

- admin.go:437 adds blockedComment.ParentUnpublished, set at :480 as `bc.Reply && !c.Published`.
- admin_blocked.html:20 prints '{{else if .ParentUnpublished}}, in reply to a comment (the report has no reader page){{else if .Reply}}, in reply to a hidden comment', so 'hidden' is reached only for a published report whose parent Find did not locate.
- internal/server/blocked_unpublished_label_test.go is the review's test, as given, and it passes here. It failed on 1753d3f.
Waived to note N-143 by decision, not acted on. internal/comments/comments.go:56-58 still says votes return this same value, while votes.go:39 declares its own. It is text only and the waiver stands.
Waived to note N-144, not acted on: internal/server/block_test.go:311 still says 'each of the six goes through' over four writes.
Waived to note N-145, not acted on: internal/server/unblock_test.go:164 still says 'in all six ways' over four writes.
Waived to note N-146, not acted on. It is the same stale doc as O-010, at internal/comments/comments.go:56-58.

cases.evidence: Unchanged from the first review: TestBlock, TestBlockedRefusals, TestBlockedPage, TestUnblockRestores, TestBlockControls, ownerRouteStatus and observe() feed every designed shape.
